rag.text:
Test: TC-4304 — Global - Gadget - Objectives - Editing objective's status and progress
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-162 Global - Gadget
Labels: can_be_automated, teamsmile

Steps:
1. Navigate to dashboardName
   Data: dashboardName: TC-4304 Global - Gadget - Roadmap - Editing objective's status and progress
   Expected: Jira dashboard page is displayed
2. Click Add gadget button

On Atlassian Cloud first click Edit button to add gadget.
   Expected: Add a gadget window appears
3. Atlassian Server: Click Load all gadgets and search for gadgetName

Atlassian Cloud: Select gadgetName
   Data: gadgetName: BigPicture Goals
   Expected: BigPicture Golas gadget is visible in the list
4. Click on Add gadget button
   Expected: Gadget is visible in the dashboard
5. Close Add gadget window
   Expected: Add gadget window disappears
6. In field Box find boxName.
   Data: boxName: TC-4304 Global - Gadget - Roadmap - Editing objective's status and progress
   Expected: boxName is added to Box field
7. Click on Save button

Atlassian Cloud: Click Done to not be in edit mode anymore
   Expected: Gadget is added. Inside gadget is TC-4304 Global - Gadget - Roadmap - Editing objective's status and progress box
8. Right click on objectiveName
   Data: objectiveName: TC-4304 Task 1
   Expected: Nothing happened. No context menu is displaying.
9. Click on percent value displayed in progress column for objectiveName and change it to progressValue
   Data: objectiveName: Objective 2

progressValue: 80
   Expected: Progress value can't be edited.
10. Click > on timeline to display TC-4587 PI2 timebox
   Expected: TC-4304 PI2 timebox is visible.
11. Right click on objectiveName
   Data: objectiveName: Objective 1
   Expected: Context menu is displaying. There are available options:

* Open
* Completed
* Failed
* Abandoned

Open option is selected.
12. Select option Completed
   Data: objectiveName: Objective 1
   Expected: objectiveName changed color to green. Value in progress column is set to 100%
13. Click on percent value displayed in progress column for objectiveName and change it to progressValue
   Data: objectiveName: TC-4304 Task 2

progressValue: 80
   Expected: Progress value for objectiveName is changed and set to progressValue
14. Click > on timeline to display TC-4304 PI3 timebox
   Expected: TC-4304 PI3 timebox is visible.
15. Right click on objectiveName
   Data: objectiveName: Objective 3
   Expected: Context menu is displaying. There are available options:

* Open
* Completed
* Failed
* Abandoned

Open option is selected.
16. Select option Abandoned
   Data: objectiveName: Objective 3
   Expected: objectiveName changed color to gray
17. Right click on objectiveName
   Data: objectiveName: TC-4304 Task 3
   Expected: Context menu is displaying. There are available options:

* Open
* Completed
* Failed
* Abandoned

Open option is selected.
18. Select option Failed
   Data: objectiveName: TC-4304 Task 3
   Expected: objectiveName changed color to red
